text:
sam: quick preflight — noticed a p95/p99 spike on /v1/embeddings in us-east around 01:10 UTC.

What I did
- rolled a targeted canary of model-variant v2-alpha earlier and saw an increased tail at ~01:05.
- temporarily shifted 20% traffic off v2-alpha to v1-stable at 01:18; error-rate dropped but p99 still elevated.

Observed
- spike aligns with a flurry of cache misses and a jump in backend queue depth on worker-nodes-3.
- a few 502s correlated with kv-timeouts (200ms -> 800ms)

Blockers
- need logs from prometheus for the 00:500:30 window with per-node network egress metrics to confirm if node-level jitter caused cache churn.
- can't repro in staging with the same workload shape.

Plan / Today
- lia to open SRE-2281 to track mitigation + postmortem if needed.
- run a controlled warmup for us-east and bump autoscaler.min_replicas to 3 for next 6h.
- add a short-runbook note: if canary increases p99 by >30% within 15m, auto-shift to fallback-pool and notify oncall.

---
lia: infra-bot created SRE-2281 and assigned to @sam :white_check_mark: details in the ticket.

omar: I can pull node egress CSVs — will attach link in 10m. also saw some intermittent pod restarts on node-3 at 01:12.

sam: good catch @omar. that could explain cold-kv issues. if you see oom/killed, we should increase pod memory.

tess: oncall here. happy to own traffic-shift and autoscaler bump. recommend adding a 5m cooldown to avoid flapping.

infra-bot: monitor-bot: Alert: us-east p99 latency > threshold -> auto-create SRE-2281 (assignee: sam)

omar: attaching snippet from node logs:
```
[01:11:58] node=worker-3 pod=cache-proxy status=Restarting reason=OOMKilled
[01:12:03] node=worker-3 pod=cache-proxy started
[01:12:10] kv_op latency=802ms key=prefix:1234
```

sam: if OOMKilled occurred, likely cache proxy evicted entries and we saw a stampede. propose: add a short jittered backoff in client, and a small local in-memory LRU as a tertiary cache.

lia: agree on backoff + local cache. I'll draft a one-paragraph runbook addition and link to SRE-2281.

tess: I'll do the autoscaler.min_replicas bump now and run a targeted warmup after pods are stable. will report back in 15m.

omar: uploaded egress and pod event logs to s3://redwood-debug/sre-2281/ — granting read to eng-sre group.

sam: thanks. action items summarized: SRE-2281 (sam/lia) / autoscaler bump + warmup (tess) / logs & pod events (omar) / runbook blurb (lia).

tess: update: bumped min_replicas=3 and triggered warmup at 01:40. initial p99 trending down — will keep observing.

sam: perfect. if p99 < 250ms for 30m we can relax autoscaler and close SRE-2281. otherwise escalate to platform-paging.

lia: adding the runbook blurb now. quick Q for @sam — prefer suppression tag on `deployment.canary=true` only or also include `model.variant`? I think both.

sam: include both tags, timebox to 20m, and require manual ack after two occurrences. noted.

omar: no further logs needed from my side. ping if you want more histograms.

tess: will post a final status here after 30m check. :coffee:

sam: handing off. thanks team.
